name: EnviTec Biogas AG
summary: EnviTec Biogas AG manufactures and operates biogas and biomethane plants in Germany, Italy, Great Britain, the Czechia Republic, Denmark, France, Denmark, the United States, Latvia, Estonia, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Own Plant operation, Service, and Plant Construction. The company engages in the planning and construction of biogas plants and biogas upgrading plants, as well as offers biological and technical, and plant and operational management services. It also generates electricity, heat, and gas in its own biogas plants. EnviTec Biogas AG was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Löhne, Germany.
